zh.title: CR50L 升降式协作机器人纸箱码垛案例
zh.subtitle: 带升降立柱的工作站，衔接纸箱取放与托盘堆垛
zh.summary: 本视频展示 CR50L 带升降配置的纸箱码垛应用。机器人配合纸箱吸取工装，在输送设备和托盘作业区域之间完成取放与转运，现场可见多层纸箱垛、升降立柱和触摸操作屏。
zh.configurationNote: 本案例采用 CR50L 带升降立柱配置，配合纸箱吸取工装、输送设备与托盘工位组成作业单元。完整型号参数与尺寸图可在 CR50L-1900 产品页查看。
zh.backgroundTitle: 把纸箱搬运与托盘作业连接起来
zh.background: 包装后的纸箱需要在输送与托盘区域之间反复抓取、移动和放置。该工作站把带升降立柱的协作机器人、纸箱吸取工装和工位控制设备布置在一起。视频记录了纸箱被吸起、抬升和转运，以及机械臂在多层纸箱垛附近进行取放的运行画面。
zh.workflowTitle: 现场动作与工作站配置

steps.title: 纸箱吸取与转运
steps.text: 末端吸取工装接触纸箱顶部，将纸箱提起并转移至作业位置。
steps.alt: CR50L 末端吸取工装从纸箱顶部抓取并抬升纸箱

steps.title: 托盘区域纸箱取放
steps.text: 机械臂将纸箱移至已有多层纸箱垛的托盘区域，衔接堆垛位置的取放动作。
steps.alt: CR50L 吸取工装和纸箱位于多层托盘纸箱垛上方

steps.title: 带升降立柱的工作站
steps.text: 现场可见机械臂安装在升降立柱上，旁侧为工作站柜体，周围布置输送设备与托盘工位。
steps.alt: CR50L 升降立柱、工作站柜体、输送设备与托盘区域的现场布局

steps.title: 操作屏与工位配套
steps.text: 柜体侧设有触摸操作屏，顶部可见状态指示灯；机器人在相邻作业位置之间衔接纸箱取放。
steps.alt: CR50L 工作站的触摸操作屏、状态灯和相邻纸箱作业位置

features: 采用 CR50L 带升降立柱的协作码垛工作站配置。
末端吸取工装从纸箱顶部执行抓取。
输送设备与托盘区域相邻布置，衔接纸箱取放与转运。
工作站配有触摸操作屏和状态指示灯。
zh.ctaTitle: 计划采用升降式纸箱码垛工作站？
zh.ctaText: 请提供纸箱尺寸与重量范围、目标小时产量、输送取料高度、托盘尺寸与垛型、目标堆垛高度和现场布局，用于核对升降配置、抓手与工位范围。

en.title: CR50L Carton Palletizing with a Lifting Column
en.subtitle: A lifting workstation for carton handling and pallet operations
en.summary: This video shows a CR50L carton palletizing application with a lifting column. The robot uses carton pickup tooling for handling and transfer around the conveyor and pallet work areas. The footage also shows a multi-layer carton stack and a workstation touchscreen.
en.configurationNote: This application uses the CR50L lifting configuration, with carton pickup tooling, conveyor equipment and pallet positions. View the CR50L-1900 product page for catalog specifications and the dimensional drawing.
en.backgroundTitle: Connecting carton handling with pallet operations
en.background: Cartons require repeated pickup, movement and placement between conveying and pallet work areas. This workstation brings together a collaborative robot on a lifting column, carton pickup tooling and local operating equipment. The video records carton lifting and transfer, together with robot handling around a multi-layer pallet stack.

steps.title: Carton pickup and transfer
steps.text: The end-of-arm pickup tooling contacts the top of a carton, lifts it and transfers it to an operating position.
steps.alt: CR50L end-of-arm pickup tooling lifting a carton from its top surface

steps.title: Handling at the pallet stack
steps.text: The robot brings the carton to the pallet area, where multiple carton layers are already present, and connects the pickup and placement movements.
steps.alt: CR50L carton pickup tooling above a multi-layer pallet stack

steps.title: Workstation with a lifting column
steps.text: The robot is mounted on a lifting column next to the workstation cabinet, with conveyor equipment and pallet positions arranged around the cell.
steps.alt: CR50L lifting column, workstation cabinet, conveyor and pallet-area layout

steps.title: Local operating equipment
steps.text: The cabinet has a touchscreen panel and visible status indicators. Robot movements connect the adjacent carton handling positions.
steps.alt: CR50L workstation touchscreen, status lights and adjacent carton handling area

features: A CR50L collaborative palletizing workstation with a lifting column.
End-of-arm carton pickup tooling engaging the carton top surface.
Conveyor equipment and pallet work areas arranged for carton handling and transfer.
A workstation touchscreen panel and status indicators.
en.ctaTitle: Planning a lifting carton palletizing workstation?
en.ctaText: Send carton dimensions and weight range, target hourly output, conveyor pickup height, pallet size and pattern, target stack height and a layout to review the lift configuration, tooling and working positions.

en.seoDescription: Watch CR50L carton handling and palletizing with a lifting column, pickup tooling and conveyor equipment. Explore the video and CR50L-1900 specifications.
